sentences.en: The speaker was so famous as to need no introduction.
sentences.zh: 这位演讲者如此有名，无需介绍。

sentences.en: The speaker was so well-known as to need no introduction.
sentences.zh: 这位演讲者如此知名，无需介绍。

sentences.en: He is proud of being a good speaker of English.
sentences.zh: 他以擅长英语口语而自豪。

senses.zh: 演讲者，发言人；扬声器，喇叭；说话者，讲某种语言的人；议长，主席
